guidance.statement: FY27 revenue growth to be better than FY26; H2 FY26 better than H1 FY26
guidance.quote: fiscal year'27 to be better than fiscal year'26

guidance.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin to remain in guided range of 22-23% (22.5-23.5% post ice cream demerger)
guidance.quote: consolidated EBITDA margin to stay around the guided range

guidance.statement: Expect low single-digit price increases across fiscal year 2027
guidance.quote: we do expect a low single-digit price increases over the year

guidance.statement: Will invest in business as needed to support sustained volume-led growth
guidance.quote: We will invest in the business as needed to support sustained growth

guidance.statement: Growth remains number 1 priority with volume-led and competitive growth strategy
guidance.quote: growth will continue to remain our Number 1 priority

delivered.statement: 6% revenue growth; 5% underlying sales growth, 4% underlying volume growth
Highest UVG in last 12 quarters at 4% underlying volume growth
EBITDA Rs. 3,788 crores up 3% YoY; EBITDA margin 23.3%
PAT before exceptional items Rs. 2,562 crores grew 1% YoY
Gross margin 50.8%, up 30 basis points YoY
Achieved highest ever Home Care market share; gained share across all categories
Quick commerce now 3% of business, growing almost 100% quarter-on-quarter

themes: Volume-led competitive growth prioritized over margin expansion
Quick commerce expansion: dedicated org, 100% QoQ growth, supply chain redesign with 1,400 bps service improvement
Portfolio transformation: Minimalist offline expansion to 25k stores; OZiva acquisition of remaining 49%
Market share gains broad-based; Home Care at highest ever levels; liquids at premium to powders
Premiumization across categories: bodywash volume tripled in 3 years; Hair Care double-digit led by Dove and TRESemmé
Macro tailwinds: lower inflation, improved consumer confidence, supportive RBI policies, improved consumption
risks: Commodity volatility and depreciating rupee increasing input costs on imported materials
Competitive pricing pressure limiting USG growth; Home Care pricing headwinds continue
Macro dependency for sustained consumption recovery acknowledged; growth tied to economic improvement
Quick commerce channel expansion creating operational complexity and margin pressure

analyst_pushback.management_response: Guiding FY27 better than FY26 with improved macro and strategic actions; won't commit to double-digit
analyst_pushback.quote: fiscal year'27 to be better than fiscal year'26

analyst_pushback.issue: Margin compression despite modest inflation supporting pricing power
analyst_pushback.management_response: Growth is priority one; full investment backing; margins stay in range via scale efficiencies
analyst_pushback.quote: top line growth will remain our number 1 priority

analyst_pushback.issue: Quick commerce cannibalization of general trade
analyst_pushback.management_response: Mix of demand shift and demand generation; q-commerce portfolio more premiumized with better margins
analyst_pushback.quote: can't assume that it's completely a cannibalization

analyst_pushback.issue: Skin Care underperformance vs. premium platforms like Nykaa
analyst_pushback.management_response: HUL is largest Skin Care business; strategy democratizes premium benefits across income pyramid
analyst_pushback.quote: we now have a portfolio that spans from D2C brands like Minimalist

tone_evidence: Highest 12-quarter UVG, highest-ever market share, broad-based growth; but cautiously avoids double-digit commitments
